Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Obtain the equivalent resistance across terminals a & b of the circuit. Also find the  
  power dissipated in the 10 Ω resistor.

2A)           For the circuit shown, the switch was in the closed position for a long time, then opened (5)  
  at time t = 0. Find the current ic(t) for t > 0.

2B)   A coil carrying a current of 2.8 A is wound on the central limb of the cast steel  
  symmetrical frame of uniform square cross section 16 cm2 (side = 4 cm) as shown.  
  Assuming no magnetic leakage and fringing, calculate the number of turns in the coil to  
  produce a flux of 1.1 mWb in the air gap of 0.2 cm length. The relative permeability of  
  cast steel is 1200.  
  
  
  (5)  
  
  
3A)   Find the Average & RMS values of the periodic function shown in the figure.  
  
  
  (4)  
  
  
3B)   A 5 kW load at 0.8 lagging power factor is being supplied by a 220 V, 50 Hz, 1-Ф  
  supply. Calculate the reactive power drawn by the source. If a capacitor connected  
  parallel to the load improves its power factor to 0.9 lagging, find the capacitance of the   (6)  
  capacitor.  
  
4A)   Three elements, a resistance of 100 Ω, an inductance of 0.1 H and a capacitance of 150  
  µF are connected in parallel to a 230 V, 50 Hz, 1-Ф supply. Calculate the current in each (4)  
  element and the supply current.  
  
4B)   Three similar coils each of resistance 7 Ω and inductance 0.03 H are connected in Δ to a  
  3-Ф, 400 V, 50 Hz, RYB supply. Determine the currents in each line and the active        (6)  
  power drawn by the load.

5A)             Three identical impedances of (10 + j 5) Ω are connected in Υ across a symmetrical 3-  
  Ф, 3-wire, 415 V, RYB system and two-wattmeter method is used to measure the  
  power consumed.  
  Determine:                                                                              (4)  
  i) The readings of each wattmeter.  
  ii) Active power supplied by the source.  
  
5B)             With a neat diagram explain the working principle of a transformer. How are they  
  classified?                                                                             (3)  
  
5C)             With a neat layout, discuss single-phase digital energy meter.  
  (3)
